domain: Geospatial and Magnetic Field Data Collection and Analysis
scenario:
A geospatial research institute is developing a sophisticated data management and analysis platform to handle magnetic field data collected from various stations across the globe. This platform will facilitate the collection, storage, and analysis of geospatial and geomagnetic data to support research on Earth's magnetic field variations and their effects on navigation, communications, and geological studies.

The system will manage data from multiple stations, each capturing a range of parameters including latitude, longitude, altitude, and magnetic field components (magx, magy, magz). Additionally, it will track the data collection time, calculate derived metrics such as the magnetic field strength and standard deviation, and associate data with specific research projects and student participants.

The platform will support the integration of digital elevation models (DEM) for precise geospatial analysis and provide tools for visualizing magnetic anomalies. It will feature advanced reporting and analytics capabilities to support research publications, facilitate collaboration among international research teams, and ensure data availability for various scientific inquiries.

User roles with tailored permissions will be implemented to manage data access, ensuring that only authorized researchers can view or modify sensitive data. The platform will also include comprehensive documentation and data export functionalities to support ongoing and future research initiatives.
